Title (plan.json title and topic.title, script title, thumbnail if it repeats it): 'Every way billionaires avoid paying tax, explained' promises more than the video shows. It covers seven moves and leaves out well-known ones (GRATs/dynasty trusts beyond a passing mention, QSBS, real-estate depreciation, carried interest). Retitle to the count the video delivers, e.g. '7 ways billionaires avoid paying tax, explained' (or 'How billionaires legally avoid tax: 7 moves').

Beat c5-saved: 'He just saved $2.4M' overstates tax-loss harvesting. Selling the loser and buying something similar resets his starting price lower, so the tax is generally deferred, not erased (unless he holds to death, move three). Say it cuts this year's bill instead, e.g. 'Taxable gain left this year: nothing. His tax bill this year drops by $2.4M.' Adjust the matching stats card label if it says 'saved'.
